top_signals.title: The Next School of War: Educating for Tomorrow’s Battlefield
top_signals.summary:
When war changes, schools change. New technology, the politics of mass mobilization and campaign design, and novel tactics that defined Napoleonic warfare led to Gerhard von Scharnhorst’s reforms and the idea of lifelong education as a professional obligation. The pattern repeated itself in the interwar period. In 1929, James Carson Breckinridge, a Marine officer, published “Some Thoughts on Service Schools” in the Marine Corps Gazette, calling for a new educational paradigm consistent with John Dewey’s ideas about pragmatism and experiential learning.War is again changing. top_signals.title: ‘Call Her Daddy’ Host Raises Money at $500M Valuation
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Ashley Carman joins Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg Deals." Unwell, the media company founded by popular podcast host Alex Cooper, has received an investment from Hollywood super agent Patrick Whitesell that values the firm at $500 million, according to people familiar with the deal.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
